report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis. ETV6::RUNX1 defines a recurrent pediatric B-ALL subgroup documented by genomic profiling in a large patient cohort. In St. Jude Total XV, ETV6::RUNX1-positive B-ALL had better event-free and overall survival than fusion-negative disease. This difference was not significant in the earlier Total XIIIA/B cohorts, supporting a treatment-specific interpretation.
